title: craft_card
description: The DISTILLED, ABSTRACT output of corpus ingestion — a reusable narrative technique (e.g. '以景结情', 'free indirect discourse') learned FROM authorized source material but carrying NO liftable prose. A craft_card points at evidence via locators + short paraphrased notes; it never stores a passage long enough to reconstruct the source. This is the anti-copy boundary BY DESIGN (mirrors the voice-card principle): the pipeline distills technique, not text.

technique.description: The ABSTRACT craft principle, in the ingester's own words.

abstracted.description: MUST be true — asserts the card is abstract features, never lifted prose.

evidence.description: Pointers into authorized sources: a locator + a SHORT paraphrased note, never the passage itself.

locator.description: Where in the source (chapter/line/para), NOT the text.

note.description: Short paraphrase of what the span demonstrates; capped so no card can smuggle a liftable passage.

rights.description: Binds the card to a source_registry entry + the allowed_use it was distilled under (public-domain study / licensed retrieval / authorized sample).
